LESSON: GROWING VEGETABLES

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade five
Subject: General
Strand: FOOD PRODUCTION PROCESSES Strand Sub strand Specific learning outcomes Suggested
Topic 2.1: Growing Vegetables
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 9

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Growing Vegetables, part of FOOD PRODUCTION PROCESSES Strand Sub strand Specific learning outcomes Suggested in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade five General.

Key inquiry question: How does growing vegetables contribute to food production?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Growing Vegetables together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
Social justice: learners foster fairness in sharing and undertaking of duties in the vegetable production project.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Financial literacy as the learners appreciate saving on cost at school or family level by growing own vegetables.

Link to other subjects:

Learners relate growing of vegetables to social economic activities in the community learnt through Social Studies.
